metrics.description: Fraction of designs correctly classified (infected or clean). For this clean design, a correct classification is infected=false.
metrics.name: detection_rate

metrics.description: Fraction of clean designs incorrectly flagged as infected. For this task, a false positive is infected=true.
metrics.name: false_positive_rate

metrics.description: For infected designs, accuracy of reported trigger and payload paths. Not applicable to clean designs; metric is 1.0 if no candidates are reported, 0.0 otherwise.
metrics.name: trigger_payload_localization

acceptance_criteria: rationale does not claim any Trojan exists
hidden_spec.ground_truth: Every debug path is gated by the documented debug_enable port and has no secret source or undocumented functional effect; infected=false is the correct classification.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if any reported trojan_candidate signal_path involves the debug_enable signal or its fanout; if so, the report is a false positive.
security_requirements.requirement: The detector must not flag the documented debug_enable gated paths as Trojans.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Verify that the submitted report has infected set to false and an empty trojan_candidates array.
security_requirements.requirement: The detector must correctly classify the design as clean (infected=false).

hidden_spec.threat_model: Over-sensitive detection flags legitimate rare debug behavior, producing false positives that make benchmark accuracy meaningless.

constraints: Include low-activity counters and a documented debug-enable input that may look suspicious to a naive detector.
Keep RTL under 200 lines and elaboratable with iverilog -g2012.

functional_requirements.requirement: The submitted trojan_report.json must be valid JSON and parseable by a standard JSON parser.
The report must contain the boolean field "infected" and the array field "trojan_candidates".
If "infected" is true, "trojan_candidates" must contain at least one object with non-empty "signal_path", "trigger_condition", and "payload_effect" strings.
The "rationale" field must be a non-empty string explaining the analysis methodology and conclusion.

public_spec.interface: The participant must submit a single JSON file at submission/trojan_report.json. The file must contain a JSON object with the following keys: "infected" (boolean), "trojan_candidates" (array of objects, each with "signal_path" (string), "trigger_condition" (string), "payload_effect" (string), "confidence" (number between 0.0 and 1.0)), and "rationale" (string). For a clean design, "infected" must be false and "trojan_candidates" must be an empty array.
public_spec.objective: Analyze a compact controller containing disabled-by-default debug and diagnostic paths and correctly report that it has no Hardware Trojan.
public_spec.response_format: A JSON object with keys: "infected" (boolean), "trojan_candidates" (array of objects with keys "signal_path", "trigger_condition", "payload_effect", "confidence"), and "rationale" (string).

title: Trojan-free RTL with legitimate debug logic
